sloka: दृष्ट्वा आश्रम पदम् शून्यम् रामो दशरथ आत्मजः।रहिताम् पर्णशालाम् च प्रविद्धानि आसनानि च ॥३-६१-१॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā āśrama padam śūnyam rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ।rahitām parṇaśālām ca praviddhāni āsanāni ca ॥3-61-1॥

translations.english: Rama, son of Dasaratha, saw the empty cottage devoid of Sita. The mats were displaced. He searched everywhere but unable to see Vaidehi lifted his lovely arms and said:
